title: A work order made with Create Work Order shows in the List at once
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • View: on Work Orders the List is shown (click List in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar; its tooltip reads "List").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST New WO Listed" (used by this case only) with one contact and one asset.

Setup

  1. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST New WO Listed" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-118" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  2. Check the setup worked: Customers > "ZZAUTOTEST New WO Listed" > Assets tab shows the asset.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click the All tab.
  2. Click Create Work Order.
  3. Pick "ZZAUTOTEST New WO Listed" as Customer and its asset as Asset > Save (if a Confirmation about the credit limit appears, click Create). Write down the number shown at the top left; close the New Line window that opens (X).
  4. Go back to Work Orders (top menu) without reloading.
  5. Click the All tab, click Search and type "ZZAUTOTEST New WO Listed".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The new work order is listed without a manual reload.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §2; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (§1 Business Case). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • QA handoff §2: “A work order created with Create Work Order appears without a manual reload.”
  • PRD §1 Business Case: “List remains the default and stays exactly as it is in production today; the only addition to the Work Orders page is the switcher that offers the two new displays.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
